modelOverview: The Cubitus is Patek Philippe's first entirely new sporty-elegant collection since the Aquanaut, launched in October 2024 with a distinctive square-cushion case and integrated bracelet. The 5821 is the flagship self-winding date model of the line, positioned alongside the Nautilus and Aquanaut as Patek's third integrated-bracelet sports watch family.

5821A-001.movement: Automatic · Patek Philippe Calibre 26-330 S C · ~35-45h power reserve
5821A-001.materials: Stainless steel case and integrated bracelet
5821A-001.bezel: Stainless steel, combination of polished and vertically satin-brushed surfaces
5821A-001.dial: Sunburst olive/khaki green dial with horizontal embossed pattern, white gold applied baton hour markers and rounded baton hands filled with luminescent material, framed date aperture at 3 o'clock
5821A-001.description: The Cubitus 5821A-001 is the steel flagship of Patek Philippe's newest integrated-bracelet sports collection, distinguished by its square-cushion case, satin and polished steel bracelet, and a striking sunburst khaki-green dial. Every piece is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.

variants.Steel – Khaki Green: Reference 5821A-001 in stainless steel with the signature sunburst khaki/olive green horizontally embossed dial, white gold applied hour markers and matching integrated steel bracelet.
